Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage
          `-- Show the controller installing issued revisions and CanvasHistoryService owning checkpoints; DiagramService is no longer the sole content writer.
      |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage
          `-- Add document.diagramContexts beneath the semantic document as compact associations to saved evidence context.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
          `-- Replace controller-side content revision issuance with installation and validation of retained revisions; preserve version checks and undo checkpoints.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Show append retaining and binding issued immutable revisions, not allocating content revisions itself.
      |-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Reorganize its obsolete sole-writer boundary into immutable revision operations, runtime retention, generation, and separate canvas publication.
      `-- [2] Add: DiagramAgentContext association and fallback
          `-- Develop MappingPage's document.diagramContexts node: fingerprint source evidence, retain a compact backing reference, and load it for an edit only while the fingerprint matches.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Reorganize the call flow around uploaded or saved context resolution, diagram-context fallback, scoped generation, revision retention, and guarded canvas application.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
          `-- Add whole-diagram or subtree replacement scope, pinned prompt references, generation options, and globally saved agentContextId.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
          `-- Add resolved context identity, generation-session output, and retained variant revisions while preserving retryable application.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
          `-- Add versioned source-range references and optional portable source files; source text is resolved separately before Pi conversion.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
          `-- Replace the in-memory SessionManager claim with a persisted session seeded from resolved context; historical tool calls remain context, not executions.
      `-- [1a] Correct: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
          `-- Distinguish revision issuance and retention from subsequent canvas installation and checkpoint binding; application retries reuse the issued revision.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Add explicit create/list/read-agent-context tools and expanded prompt-generation operations to the existing interface groups.
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Show AgentContextService resolving either scoped uploads or saved IDs and DiagramEditService applying retained revisions after generation.
      `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Add AgentContextLibrary beneath Agent context as owner of explicit saved-context creation, listing, and reading; attach its subsystem overview there.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
          `-- Add FileAgentContextRepository, shared source blobs, and FileDiagramAgentContextStore beside the existing persistence owners; distinguish compact stored references from portable expanded contexts.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Include document diagram-context associations and separately stored backing records; autosave still does not publish catalog revisions.
  `-- [3] Saved AgentContexts and source evidence  new canvas
      |-- Saved-context ownership
          `-- Show AgentContextLibrary creating, listing, and reading explicit immutable contexts, separate from scoped conversation uploads; connect from Mapping backend's AgentContextLibrary node.
      |-- Immutable records and request retries
          `-- Develop FileAgentContextRepository: request-hash conflict checks, exclusive atomic publication, and IDs reusable across canvases.
      `-- Pinned source capture and lazy resolution
          `-- Develop FileAgentContextSources: capture Git commits or content hashes, retain compact range references and shared blobs, and resolve source text separately when needed.
